facts.text: I am looking for advice on how to negotiate a collaboration with a brand.
I landed a potential collaboration with a brand that reached out to me after seeing my tweets using the hashtag #socialmediamarketing.
I want to make sure I get a good deal in the collaboration.
I want to include a clause that ensures the brand promotes my content on their social media channels as part of the collaboration.
I want to consider what type of content the brand will be promoting.
I want to make sure I have control over the messaging and aesthetic of my brand.
I want to ask the brand about their content calendar and how they plan to incorporate my content into their overall social media strategy.
I want to make sure my content is promoted at times when it will get the most visibility and engagement.
I want to ask the brand about their strategy for responding to comments and messages on my promoted content.
I want to make sure the brand is not just promoting my content and then ignoring conversations that come from it.
I want to ask how success of the collaboration will be measured.
I want to ask what metrics will be used to determine if the partnership is meeting goals and objectives.
I want to ask what kind of content the brand will be most interested in promoting on their social media channels.
I have tweets about social media marketing that I might have the brand promote.
I have book reviews that I might have the brand promote.
I have fitness-related posts that I might have the brand promote.
